ja: 機駕の忠臣“徐晃サーペント”が遂に立体化しBB戦士に登場！ 武器の斧は様々な形に組み換え可能 鎧とバックパックは大型武器に合体 背中の翼型パーツは曹操ガンダム（別売）のパワーアップパーツになる
en: Machinery's loyal retainer "Xu Huang Serpent" has finally become three-dimensional and appears in BB Senshi! The weapon ax can be rearranged into various shapes. The armor and backpack can be combined into a large weapon. The wing-shaped parts on the back can be used as power-up parts for Cao Cao Gundam (sold separately).
